newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa says Q1 results to top year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa says Q1 results to top year-ago.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Lufthansa AG, reporting strong growth in passenger levels, said on Monday its first quarter results would be above year-ago levels.

Lufthansa said the higher passenger count, which included a 3.3 percent increase year-on-year in seat utilisation, was marked by high growth in long-haul traffic but trouble in its domestic market at a time of European airline deregulation.
Lufthansa said it would release first quarter results on May 7. In the 1996 first quarter, Lufthansa reported a 5.8 percent rise in sales but a loss from ordinary activities of 49 million marks.
